consequence.statement: The operator must execute the documented upgrade steps (helm repo add, helm upgrade, and pod verification) to complete the migration to Crossplane v2.0.0; failure to follow these steps will prevent successful upgrade completion.

original.statement: Upgrading Crossplane to v2.0.0 requires executing the documented migration steps: adding the Crossplane Helm repository, upgrading via helm upgrade, and verifying the upgrade completion.

decision.reason: [ev-c28095f20093] is just the standard upgrade procedure: add the Helm repo, run helm upgrade, then check the pods. It does not describe a change in Crossplane v2, and it says nothing about anything failing, being rejected or needing migration if an operator skips these steps; skipping them simply means not upgrading. Calling this migration-required (mandatory work, high severity) claims more than the evidence supports, and no other consequence follows from this text.
